Purpose: Row key. Genesys conversation ID of the dropped call (search it in Performance > Interactions).
Conversation start time (ISO 8601 UTC) from the conversation record.
Conversation end time (ISO 8601 UTC). Blank if the agent was still in after-call work when the row was written.
Raw disconnectType from the customer.end event (ERROR / SYSTEM / TIMEOUT / TRANSPORT_FAILURE ...).
Readable category derived from DisconnectType by the workflow.
Value of the ErrorCode participant attribute set by your flows.
Value of the ErrorMessage participant attribute (or the lookup failure text).
Caller number as delivered by the event.
Dialled number as delivered by the event.
First queue the call was in (blank if it never reached a queue).
First agent on the call (blank if it dropped before an agent).
OK / LOOKUP_FAILED / LOOKUP_TIMEOUT - health of the conversation lookup data action.
For your operations team: set to Yes once the call has been investigated.
